verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas works with legal documents (Cooley templates, incorporation documents, SAFE tracking), so contract tracking is a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows no capability to track contract renewals, expirations, or obligations, and no automatic alerts. SAFE tracking during fundraising is an adjacent feature, not contract-lifecycle management, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can track contract renewals, expirations, and obligations with automatic alerts
